conf.comment: Tanium threat-response / syslog-kv: Connect emits one line of key=value pairs (quoted, space-containing keys such as "Alert Id"). serde-KVP the attribute body into tanium_fields per recommendations.direct.cribl. This work order's field table for this format is empty by design (attributes mirror the JSON format's columns, not enumerated here), so only columns named in the recommendation prose (Alert Id, Computer Name, Intel Name) are mapped; the nested Match Details/ATT&CK data this flat format cannot carry, plus host.ip/rule.id (need 'endpoint address'/'intel id' columns not attested here), are documented gaps. Direct route, no guard hop.
